verdict.rationale: Statsig is a feature-flag, experimentation and analytics platform, not an AI agent or MCP host, so consuming external MCP servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the server role: Statsig's own MCP server and Docs MCP server expose Statsig to clients like Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT. That server-side evidence does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
